description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Tabs' which renders a horizontal, accessible tab interface with styled buttons indicating different sections. It accepts props such as a list of tabs, the currently active tab, and a callback for tab change events. The component ensures accessibility roles and labels are properly set, and it supports customization via className and aria-label.

methods.name: Tabs({ tabs = [], activeKey, onChange, className = "", "aria-label": ariaLabel = "Section tabs", })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a set of horizontal tabs with accessibility features. It accepts a list of tab objects, the active tab key, and an onChange callback to handle tab selection updates.
